## Study recruitment

The MPX NYC survey was open from 30 August to 15 November, 2022, but recruited $70\%$ participants in two 48 hour periods: half were recruited from 30 to 31 Aug, and another 20% from 10 to 11 September (see @tbl-recruitment). Over these periods, the MPX NYC recruitment advertisements were shown to users of Grindr in New York City upon logging on to the app.


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: Participants in MPX NYC Study by Sex / Physical Contact in Congregate Setting in past 4 weeks
#| label: tbl-recruitment


make_table_data_recruitment()  |>
  draw_table_by_groupSex()


```
